newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on European currencies but was trading easier against the U.S. unit and the rand on Monday, foreign exchange dealers said.

"I don't know which customer is in the market but people are just buying and the dollar has gone down from where it opened. We've seen the Reserve Bank come in to check and any time they might come in to support our dollar," a dealer said.
He said the Zimbabwe unit had opened at 10.7175/7375 against the U.S. dollar but had slipped to 10.7350/7550 by 0720 GMT. This compared with 10.7150/7350 at last Friday's close.
It was also weaker versus the rand at 2.3200/3400 compared to 2.3170/3240 but strengthened to 18.0300/0500 against sterling from 18.0560/1000.
The Zimbabwe dollar also registered gains on the mark at 7.0800/1000 from 7.1370/1530.
